metadata.description: ParaDOCS is skills and rules for Paragon technical Markdown authoring in Cursor. The paragon-tech-docs skill is the primary way to write Paragon technical documentation; bundled rules reinforce structure, style, and quality. Prerequisites: Paragon team sign-in with Team Marketplace access. Enable from Team Marketplace and Reload Window. Convert MCP may return in a later release.
